hints.title: Impartial Game Invariants
hints.text: The game of Nim is an impartial game played under normal play convention, completely characterized by Sprague-Grundy theorem.

hints.title: Bitwise Cumulative Sum
hints.text: Compute the exclusive-or sum across all pile sizes to determine whether the starting state is winning or losing.

hints.title: Winning State Condition
hints.text: A position is winning if and only if the bitwise cumulative sum of all piles is non-zero.
